$meta.source: docs/BRAND.md v3 (light-first), verified against the CSS served at https://aurahomes.fun
$meta.license: Marks are the project's (MIT repo); fonts SIL OFL 1.1, vendored in assets/fonts/

ground.name: paper
ground.role: every ground — warm paper white, never pure #fff

ground.name: faint
ground.role: tertiary text, axis labels — decorative scale only

accent.name: emerald
accent.role: THE accent — fills, bars, rules, buttons; fails AA as text

accent.name: emerald-deep
accent.role: emerald as body-scale text on light

accent.name: emerald-label
accent.role: large display + tracked labels; never lighter than #0e9f6e

context.name: violet-fill
context.role: on-chain fills — never on a first-look surface

context.name: teal
context.role: secondary system notes; bridge to Aura-H2O (BRAND.md fill-scale #0d9488)

context.name: lime
context.role: land / growth notes; bridge to Aura-Farms

aurora-band.rule: inside media and the mark only — never as ground, never as text

chip.name: dark-chip
chip.role: favicon / avatar only — an avatar is a contained shape

display.case: sentence case; may end in a period

mono.role: tracked caps labels, FIG. tags, tables, code; tabular figures in columns

motion.rules: damped, never bouncy; scroll owns the timeline; prefers-reduced-motion gets a still of equal beauty

logo.rule: never redraw the silhouette, never add glow, never outline it

variants.logo-light: light-native fill — leads everywhere on paper
variants.logo-dark-context: night fill — inside framed dark media only
variants.logo-mono-ink: single-color ink — print, embossing, single-color contexts on light
variants.logo-mono-white: single-color white — over photography and dark media
variants.avatar-chip: #050807 chip + night mark — favicon and avatars only

co-branding.lockup: A KR8TIV AI PRODUCT in tracked caps, circular badge at text height beside it
co-branding.rule: Aura mark leads, KR8TIV badge closes — never an equal-size partnership lockup
